say:0:1110912001:0.text: It has to be her, that treasure hunter.
say:0:1110912001:0.source_cn: 肯定是她，那个宝藏猎人。

say:1:1110912002:0.text: But Atalanta has no reason to steal from Satrana... Perhaps she picked it up on the street?
say:1:1110912002:0.source_cn: 但、但阿塔兰忒没理由拿萨忒娜的东西……也许是她在路上捡到的？

say:2:1110912003:0.text: I don't care about her reasons as long as I get the necklace back. Where do you think she is?
say:2:1110912003:0.source_cn: 我不在乎理由，只想拿回项链。她现在会在哪里？
